Interface VirtualServer

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiServer, SocketServer, SocketServerHandler
public interface VirtualServer extends Remote
This interface defines the methods for server-side operations that can be invoked remotely by a client. It serves as a generic representation of the server, allowing different underlying communication technologies (RMI, Socket) to implement it.

Methods declared in this interface are expected to throw Exception to signal any issues that prevent the successful completion of the operation. These exceptions can arise from low-level network communication failures or from application-level logical errors encountered during the execution of the requested operation on the server.
